name: Transactions
description: Personal income, expenses, transfers, amounts, currencies, dates, and counterparties.
notes: Create the account with Financial Accounts, then append ledger entries using its contextId. Portfolio apps can use the same account without installing this ledger module.

capture.identity: Match the Financial Accounts parent and imported transaction identifier or selected ledger entry.
exclude: A bill, budget target, wishlist interest or position snapshot as a completed movement of money.
capture.workflow: Record actual ledger facts and link supporting receipts; do not create a second account identity.
